config_text:
# The all-sky sweep (exoplan sweep): every SPOC 2-minute target of a sector, Probes only.
# Every consensus dip is kept (min_planet_fraction = 0) and classified by variables.py, which applies the
# potential-planet share itself (half the panel's weight). See CONTRIBUTING.md to run it with Sentinels.

[run]
name = "sweep"
subject_days = 13.0
min_points = 300
bin_minutes = 10.0
detrend_window_days = 1.0
search = "sector"        # one BLS search per star over the whole sector

[search]
min_period = 0.5
fap_trials = 0           # no block-bootstrap FAP in the sweep: 50 trials cost about 2 minutes a star
fap_cache = ""
fit_transits = true
stellar = "none"         # Teff, log g and R★ come from the light-curve file's header (no TIC query)

[aggregate]
cluster_gap_days = 0.05
min_score = 0.5
min_planet_fraction = 0.0   # keep every consensus dip; the classifier applies the 0.5 potential-planet share

[[reviewers]]
type = "simulated"
id = "volunteer-sensitive"
snr_threshold = 4.5
miss_probability = 0.05
seed = 11

[[reviewers]]
type = "simulated"
id = "volunteer-typical"
snr_threshold = 5.0
miss_probability = 0.10
seed = 12

[[reviewers]]
type = "simulated"
id = "volunteer-cautious"
snr_threshold = 5.5
miss_probability = 0.15
seed = 13
order: sha256 of '<sector>:<tic>', ascending (a fixed pseudo-random order: a slice is a fair sample)
